suppressedVulnerability.name: CVE-2025-69993
suppressedVulnerability.description: Leaflet versions up to and including 1.9.4 are vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the bindPopup() method. This method renders user-supplied input as raw HTML without sanitization, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary JavaScript code through event handler attributes (e.g., ). When a victim views an affected map popup, the malicious script executes in the context of the victim's browser session.
suppressedVulnerability.notes: False positive: application only uses leaflet via react-leaflet's <Popup> component API (React children, auto-escaped), never the raw bindPopup(string) HTML sink that CVE-2025-69993 describes. See docs/casa-evidence/dependency-scan-owasp.md for detail.
